_comment_detect: Evidence from agent output. Sections whose name maps to a token (via aliases) count automatically if they contain data. direct: extra conditions for 'data arrives' (discovery missing). runtime: service/process is running (agent plug-in missing). not_on_os: cmk/os_family values where the plug-in does not run. Conditions: section:<sec>[/<sub>]:data | section:<sec>[/<sub>]:contains:<regex> | systemd:<regex> | process:<regex> | winservice:<regex> (re.search, anchor as needed).
_comment_section_data: A section has data if it has at least one line that is not empty, not a [subsection] header and not matching no_data_lines. section_data.<section>: additionally one data line must match the regex.
_comment_section_ignore: Sections that never count as evidence.
